notes: «- المعنى واحد -» is an editor gloss and is left out
«غير، واحد» is an unnamed co-transmitter in the head level, not a name
«قالوا حدثنا يونس بن محمد» joins the heads; the chain continues through قتادة to الحسن and أبي هريرة
the matn is followed by Tirmidhi's comment and by «ويروى عن أيوب ويونس بن عبيد وعلي بن زيد قالوا لم يسمع الحسن من أبي هريرة»; read as a note on the link, not a route, and not written
needs_ruling: whether the «ويروى عن أيوب» sentence is a second route after the saying (rule 4) or commentary cannot be settled from the rules
